name: Beatriz Oliveira
bio:
Beatriz Oliveira's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly after completing her degree in Communications. Initially drawn to Formula 1 after seeing a race in person, she quickly realized the power of storytelling in the high-octane world of racing. Beatriz thrives on crafting compelling narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike, ensuring the team's image is always polished and engaging.

Beatriz believes in a proactive and data-driven approach to PR. She meticulously tracks media coverage, analyzes social media trends, and leverages her network of contacts to maximize exposure. She is always looking for innovative ways to connect with audiences, from creating behind-the-scenes content to organizing exclusive events. Beatriz is distinguished by her exceptional communication skills, her ability to build relationships with journalists and influencers, and her unwavering dedication to her team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back into a high ponytail during events.
physical.description: Beatriz has a slender build and a radiant smile that instantly puts people at ease.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a lucky scarf she wears to every race.
Prefers to conduct meetings standing up.
